name: youtube-analytics
description: Reads YouTube Reporting API jobs, report types, report metadata, YouTube Analytics groups and group items, and safely plans documented job/group mutations via the Google OAuth 2.0 refresh-token grant.

risk.read: external YouTube Reporting and YouTube Analytics API reads of reporting jobs, report types, report metadata, groups, and group items
risk.approval: reverse ETL mutations are available only through plan, preview, explicit approval, and destructive confirmation where required

conformance.reason: custom-auth-only (mode:custom AuthHook, no when-gated non-custom fallback); hook-covered, proven live by archived parity evidence for youtube-analytics (the AuthHook's real OAuth2 refresh-grant path) -- conformance's synthetic config has no real HTTPS token_url and cannot exercise mode:custom auth at all, so every auth-resolving dynamic check (read or write) would otherwise fail identically and uninformatively (gmail precedent, docs/migration/conventions.md §4). Static api-surface, schema, fixture-shape, and hook tests remain active.
